# AAC Choice Board

A question with a grid of AAC picture choices, played at Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced level, with spoken prompts and feedback.

Part of [Little Voices](../little-voices/ActivityLibrary/little-voices), AAC sing-along songs and nursery rhymes by @ctse.
